title: install-surge-prep-sprint-snapshot-mar-12-2027
body:
Sprint snapshot: preparing for install surge week (queue of 6 onsite/on-VPC installs, priority mix: 2 enterprise PCI, 3 mid-market VPC, 1 on-prem air-gapped). Quick notes from standup + triage (informal capture; will iterate into action tracker).

Context and objective:
- Goal: rehearse preflight, triage known customer network quirks, and lock down staffing for March 18-26 surge window. Reduce first-time-install mean time to ready by 30%.
- Current open installs: ENGDEP-4821 (Azure VNet + private KMS), ENGDEP-4830 (on-prem rack with legacy switches), ENGDEP-4833 (customer uses overlapping CIDRs), ENGDEP-4838 (air-gapped proof-of-concept), ENGDEP-4840 (dedicated GPU networking), ENGDEP-4845 (multi-region VPC failover).

Today's wins (quick):
- Preflight checklist automation script v2 passed smoke on 3 test images; reduces manual checklist time by ~18 minutes per install (Lena).
- Network lab reproduced overlapping CIDR failure case (Ethan) and we validated the routing shim workaround.
- New SSH session backoff added to installer to avoid flapping on flaky NAT gateways (Priya).

Active blockers and risk digest:
- Customer ENGDEP-4821: KMS integration failing due to tenant IAM policy. Blocker: security team needs short-lived role from customer; awaiting response since 2027-03-09. Risk: install delay > SLAT target. Owner: Jamal.
- Node driver mismatch surfaced on 2x A100 nodes for ENGDEP-4840. Kernel module rmmod failure during reprovisioning. Temporary workaround: manual module force-unload and reboot. Root cause hypothesis: OEM custom kernel patches. Owner: Ethan.
- Overlapping CIDR (ENGDEP-4833): routing shim works but breaks on cross-account peering scenarios. Need a durable design for peering topologies. Owner: Lena; escalation if not resolved by 2027-03-15.
- Air-gapped image signing chain for ENGDEP-4838 not finalized (legal + security review). Without signed artifacts can't proceed to install. Owner: Priya.

Preflight metrics (last 7 days):
- 21 preflight runs, 14 green, 7 partial failures (network/NAT/DNS).
- Median preflight time: 34m (goal: <= 25m).
- Most common failure: DNS resolution to private registries (4/7 failures).
- Observed variance tied to customer's proxy auth headers stripping - added detection rule to preflight.

Field/Customer notes (individual installs):
- ENGDEP-4821 (Fintech customer): customer requested explicit IP allowlist for Redis cache; Ops to validate IP stability window (Jamal).
- ENGDEP-4830 (Telco): onsite rack has vendor-managed top-of-rack switch with older NX firmware; plan: coordinate maintenance window with vendor or use PCI bypass network path.
- ENGDEP-4845 (Retail multi-region): Secrets rotation cadence mismatch between our agent and customer's vault; implementing poll-based reconciliation to avoid token expiry mid-install.

Temporary mitigations deployed this week:
- Routing shim prototype (branch: routing-shim/overlap-fix) validated in lab; added in smoke tests.
- Preflight DNS detection now flags proxy header stripping and suggests workaround steps in checklist UI.
- SSH backoff and installer retries deployed to staging; reduced flake restarts by ~60% in test harness.

Action items (owner -> due):
- Jamal -> contact customer ENGDEP-4821 security contact for KMS short-lived role; due 2027-03-13.
- Ethan -> escalate kernel mismatch to infra-eng and assemble repro kernel symbols; due 2027-03-14.
- Lena -> design cross-account peering pattern doc and post to confluence; due 2027-03-15.
- Priya -> finalize signed artifact workflow and capture legal checklist items; due 2027-03-16.
- Aisha -> confirm surge staffing roster and create calendar blocks for on-call rotation 2027-03-18 to 2027-03-26; due 2027-03-13.

Escalations and SLAs:
- If ENGDEP-4821 KMS role not provisioned by 2027-03-14, escalate to customer success + sales for executive outreach.
- Kernel driver repro required before we commit to GPU install slot; otherwise reassign slot and offer later window.

Open questions / unknowns:
- Can the telco vendor apply a non-disruptive NX firmware patch within our install window? (depends on vendor SLAs).
- For overlapping CIDR customers, do we prefer stash NAT gateways per customer or centralized routing shim? Tradeoffs: cost vs operational complexity.
- Air-gapped signing: can we accept offline HSM export for intermediate certs under security policy? (security review in flight).

KB / doc updates needed:
- Update Private Install Runbook v3 with SSH backoff guidelines and new preflight DNS detector (confluence:Private-Install-Runbook-v3).
- Add kernel mismatch troubleshooting checklist to Onsite Node Troubleshooting doc.
- Add routing shim design note to architecture repo (link will be added once Lena posts).

Meeting requests / coordination:
- Blocker sync Friday 2027-03-12 16:00 PT (all owners) to confirm KMS path or trigger exec escalation.
- Surge readiness dry-run on 2027-03-16 09:00 PT (lab): full preflight on a representative customer config and one live failover.

Notes-to-self / loose thoughts:
- Consider lightweight telemetry agent to snapshot kernel & driver versions pre-install to avoid blind repro steps.
- Track preflight time per engineer to see if automation gains persist after surge starts.

Appendix (quick links):
- Deploy scripts PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy-scripts/pull/241
- Related tickets: ENGDEP-4821, ENGDEP-4830, ENGDEP-4833, ENGDEP-4840, ENGDEP-4845
- Confluence runbook: confluence:Private-Install-Runbook-v3

End of snapshot. Will convert to action tracker and update owners in Linear after blocker sync.
